title: MambaOPU: An FPGA Overlay Processor for State-space-duality-based Mamba Models
problem: Mamba2 state-space models are memory-bound due to irregular broadcast element-wise multiplications and structured sparse computations; neither CPU nor standard GPU achieve good compute efficiency.
motivation: Mamba2 models are emerging as transformer alternatives with linear complexity; efficient hardware support is critical for adoption.
method: FPGA overlay processor using: (1) operator fusion combining broadcast multiply and summation into single descriptor, backward shifting embeds segment multiply in subsequent ops to reduce path length; (2) sparse computation skipping via tensor-reorder-and-group + sparse data fetcher; (3) reconfigurable systolic array for linear operation support with improved data reuse.
key_novelty: Operator fusion + sparsity skipping + reconfigurable systolic array for memory-bound SSM acceleration.
contributions: MambaOPU FPGA overlay for state-space-duality models
1812x throughput vs CPU, 880.79x vs A100 GPU
12908x energy efficiency vs CPU, 24.27x vs GPU
limitations: Not discussed; scalability to larger models and comparison to specialized Mamba ASICs not explored.
primary_theme: FPGA-optimized state-space model acceleration for Mamba2
